title: Dominoes
tagline: Match the ends, empty your hand.
setupSubtitle: 2–4 players • double-six set • draw from the boneyard when stuck
metaDescription: Play classic Draw Dominoes online or pass-and-play: match the open ends, draw from the boneyard, and be first to empty your hand. 2–4 players, with bots.
secrecyNote: Tiles are hidden by determinism, not a server — both players shuffle the same set from one seed.
privateHandsHint: Show a tap-to-reveal screen between turns so the next player can't see your tiles.
tableStyleHint: Classic flat board, or an animated 3D table.

menu.localSubtitle: Pass & play on one device, or against bots

status.youDraw: No move — draw from the boneyard
status.youPass: No tiles left to draw — you must pass

emptyLineHint: Lay the first bone to start the line
passHint: Make sure only you can see the screen.
wonBlocked: Won on fewest pips ({{pips}}) — the board was blocked.
tieSubtitle: Blocked board — tied on fewest pips.
